standard: Doughty T57000 / T57200 half coupler & hook clamp (Ø48-51 barrel)
description: Stage-rigging half coupler / hook clamp (Doughty T57000/T57200 class) as a six-body assembly: hinged upper and lower shell around the standard Ø48-51 barrel, hinge pin, swivel closing bolt with ring thread, its pivot pin, and a DIN 315-style wing nut whose internal rings nest between the bolt rings. All mates are contact-or-clearance; the hook-clamp variant replaces the tang eye with the protruding M12 stud.
source: Doughty T57000/T57010/T58080/T58100/T57200 datasheets (bore, width, eye, base drop, stud); cross-checked vs Riggatec/Global Truss/Kupo; wall/tang/lug proportions
